title: So You Want to Talk About Race
author: Ijeoma Oluo
summary: Ijeoma Oluo takes on questions like privilege, microaggressions and police violence in short chapters, explaining the issues and giving readers ways to talk about race honestly with others.
readIf: you want a clear, direct starting point for conversations about race in America.
skipIf: you already read widely on race and want deeper academic or historical analysis.
